flucan.definition: n. Soft clayey matter in the vein, or surrounding it.

fluckiger's nepaline.translation: [医] 弗吕基格氏假乌头硷

flucloronide.translation: [化] 氟氯奈德; 氟二氯松

flucloxacillin.translation: 氟氯西林, 2,6-氟氯苯甲异青霉素

fluctuant.definition:
a. Moving like a wave; wavering
a. showing undulation or fluctuation; as, a fluctuant
   tumor.
a. Floating on the waves.
fluctuant.translation: a. 变动的, 波动的, 起伏的

fluctuate.definition:
v. cause to fluctuate or move in a wavelike pattern
v. move or sway in a rising and falling or wavelike pattern
v. be unstable
fluctuate.translation:
vi. 变动, 起伏, 动摇
vt. 使波动, 使动摇

fluctuated.translation: v. 波动, 涨落, 起伏( fluctuate的过去式和过去分词 )

fluctuates.definition:
v cause to fluctuate or move in a wavelike pattern
v move or sway in a rising and falling or wavelike pattern
v be unstable
fluctuates.translation: v. 波动, 涨落, 起伏( fluctuate的第三人称单数 )

fluctuating.definition: s. having unpredictable ups and downs

fluctuating effective rate of return.translation: [经] 变动的实际盈利率, 波动性实际报酬率

fluctuation.definition:
n. a wave motion
n. the quality of being unsteady and subject to changes
fluctuation.translation:
n. 变动, 波动, 动摇
[化] 涨落; 起伏; 波动; 脉动

fluctuations.definition:
n a wave motion
n an instance of change; the rate or magnitude of change
n the quality of being unsteady and subject to changes
fluctuations.translation: n. 起伏现象；变动；波动（fluctuation的复数）

fluctuations in exchange.translation: [经] 汇率变动, 汇兑涨落

fluctuations in investment securities.translation: [经] 投资有价证券的价格变动

fluctuations of world market prices.translation: [经] 世界市场价格的变动
